reviews.text: Professionalism and availability

I recently returned from this clinic unfortunately for something very bad, I had to put my dog ​​to sleep forever. I found a very professional doctor, empathetic and very sweet with my dog ​​and with us and he thought of the dog's well-being and not of profit, a truly exceptional person.

I've been a client of this veterinary practice for several years and have always brought my three dogs and my cat here, even for checkups and major surgeries. Fortunately, my pets have been doing well lately, so I simply called to request a prescription for a flea treatment.

When I was told there would be a charge for the prescription, I accepted without hesitation. I simply explained that I would make the transfer the next day because I was driving at the time. The response I received from the receptionist, however, was very unpleasant: she told me rather sternly that the prescription would not be sent until I sent a copy of the transfer.

It's definitely not a question of the €5 fee, but of the attitude toward a long-standing client. After years of mutual trust, I would have expected more friendly and humane treatment. It's a shame, because incidents like this also undermine the value of a relationship built over time.
Very good, kind and prepared
Very helpful and kind.

I made an appointment for my two-month-old kitten's first checkup at 11:30 a.m.
The secretary urged me to be punctual, so I arrived early (11:20 a.m.) at the clinic, finding people waiting their turn. At 12:10 p.m., still waiting and having other commitments, I reluctantly had to cancel my appointment because I had to return to work.

I want to thank Dr. Federico Berardi infinitely for the gentle kindness and empathy he showed my beloved cat when he had to accompany him on his final journey to the bridge! I am infinitely grateful for giving him dignity until the end! Thank you.
Humane and empathetic doctors

We went without an appointment in mid-August. A blonde doctor was there and after about five minutes of examining the dog, without even examining him or touching him, she told us there was nothing she could do. They need to run tests, but I can't do them. It's definitely the teeth (she didn't even open the dog's mouth; I repeat, she didn't touch it) and you need to intervene quickly. Make appointments, but they're all on vacation, so we'll talk about it later. I asked her for a swollen tongue, please, and she didn't want to put that in either. So after this five-minute visit, we paid €35 ​​(which we absolutely didn't have to).
Obviously, it wasn't the teeth; it was a very common bacterial inflammation under the dog's chin, which is sagging due to the dog's age. NEVER AGAIN!

1 because I couldn't put 0!
Dr. Riccardo first mistakes a tumor for a cyst, then he's too busy to talk to people (I know they're anxious), but they waited in silence for over two hours to talk to him! And he wanted to pass the buck to another vet (maybe she was even a much better one)!

I called the clinic two days ago because my 15-year-old dog was sick and asked if I could take her in for an immediate visit or at least speak to a vet. The receptionist rudely replied that since it was August, they only had one vet available and no one was available. It was possible to go, much less speak to him because he was examining, but I had to bring her the next day at 7 pm. Are you kidding? I took her to another facility where she was welcomed with love and examined immediately. Zero sensitivity at such a delicate time. I will never go again. If it had been possible to give 0 stars, I would have. I'm sorry because I've always had a good experience, but in this case, there's just no empathy for the situation.

Not even one star!!!!
If you have a parrot, don't bring it to them!!! They pretend to be avian vets, but they're not.
Friendly and kind with customers and with my cats!

Always excellent service. They've helped me with my 13-year-old dog on several occasions. I especially appreciate the precision and professionalism of Dr. Palma, with whom Leo and I had a great experience. Recommended.
A terrible experience. Just for asking a question, I was verbally assaulted by a rude, awkward, and arrogant doctor. I'll never set foot in that place again.
I've been going to this clinic for 5 years now! It's a must-go place for my kittens! The staff is friendly and professional!
